Strange as I thought an x-ray would be the first step to see what it actually is, god help me if it is the big C. Very unprofessional and seemingly not interested in actually seeing me or diagnosing the issue.

From my previous appointments (the ones I managed to get through the grace of god) I have found this practice to be a never ending cycle of:  tell me what I already know, refer me to people who can't possibly help, and look to Google for answers.
